candidate.user_input: When can an employee use the 50 percent split disbursement option, and which expenses are excluded from this option?
candidate.reference: All requests may use the split disbursement option when applicable: 50% of the approved opportunity cost can be reimbursed after payment; the remaining 50% can be reimbursed upon completion. This option does not apply to travel, hotel, or meal expenses.

evidence.quote:
All requests may use the split disbursement option when applicable:

- 50% of the approved opportunity cost can be reimbursed after payment
- the remaining 50% can be reimbursed upon completion

This option does not apply to travel, hotel, or meal expenses.
evidence.contribution: Defines the timing of the 50% split disbursement and specifies excluded expenses

candidate.connection: The quote directly states the timing for the 50% split disbursement and the exclusions for travel, hotel, and meal costs.
